name: Clippy
tagline: Privacy focused clipboard manager with sync and encryption
blurb: Clippy is a clipboard manager built with Rust and TypeScript.
description:
Clippy is a clipboard manager built with Rust and TypeScript.
It supports text, images, files, HTML, and RTF content with
smart search, favorites, and customizable hotkeys.

Features include:

• Multi-content support (text, HTML, RTF, images, files)

• Cloud sync via Google Drive with end-to-end encryption

• Type out clipboard content where pasting is not allowed

• Smart search for links, colors, images, and hex codes

• Customizable global hotkeys and keyboard shortcuts

• Dark and light mode with multiple language support

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
